title: ASP error
description: The JSON-RPC error object for a failure-to-evaluate. data.failClass is authoritative for host fail-policy; code is advisory. Negative assessments and host deny decisions are never errors.

code.description: Advisory. ASP reserves the JSON-RPC server-error range -32099..-32000; see the registry below.

registry.description: Reserved codes and their authoritative failClass. code is advisory; failClass governs fail-policy.
